caption: Rename status to state: the preview lists each change in Projects.base, with the YAML comment note.
eval: (async () => { const P = app.plugins.plugins['bases-property-repair']; if (!window.__bpr) { window.__bpr = {}; for (const f of app.vault.getFiles()) if (f.path.startsWith('Bases Property Repair/') && (f.extension === 'base' || f.extension === 'md') && !f.path.includes('Restore copies')) window.__bpr[f.path] = await app.vault.read(f); } for (const [p, t] of Object.entries(window.__bpr)) await app.vault.modify(app.vault.getFileByPath(p), t); P.closeModals(); P.pro.signOut(); const m = P.openRepair([{ from: 'status', to: 'state' }]); await m.scan(); { const r = m.modalEl.querySelector('.bpr-results'); const el = r.querySelector('.bpr-file[data-path$="Projects.base"]'); r.scrollTop = el.offsetTop - r.offsetTop; } return 'ok'; })()

caption: Apply writes a restore copy first, then the new text, and shows the result for each file.
eval: (async () => { const P = app.plugins.plugins['bases-property-repair']; if (!window.__bpr) { window.__bpr = {}; for (const f of app.vault.getFiles()) if (f.path.startsWith('Bases Property Repair/') && (f.extension === 'base' || f.extension === 'md') && !f.path.includes('Restore copies')) window.__bpr[f.path] = await app.vault.read(f); } for (const [p, t] of Object.entries(window.__bpr)) await app.vault.modify(app.vault.getFileByPath(p), t); P.closeModals(); P.pro.signOut(); const m = P.openRepair([{ from: 'status', to: 'state' }]); await m.scan(); for (const f of app.vault.getMarkdownFiles()) if (f.path.startsWith('Bases Property Repair/')) await app.fileManager.processFrontMatter(f, (fm) => { if ('status' in fm) { fm.state = fm.status; delete fm.status; } }); await m.apply(); { const r = m.modalEl.querySelector('.bpr-results'); const el = r.querySelector('.bpr-file[data-path$="Board.base"]'); r.scrollTop = el.offsetTop - r.offsetTop; } return 'ok'; })()
